objective: Produce two routed, mechanically coherent and quoteable R2-EVT1 PCBAs without changing the reviewed H0-H5 functional, safety or exact-component boundary.

mechanical_stack.architecture: four pass-through M2.5 nylon screws clamp the two PCBAs through four unthreaded compression stops; enclosure capture lips and anti-shear datums carry ordinary side load
mechanical_stack.exact_screw_length_status: pending H6 enclosure front/rear bearing thickness and retained-thread geometry
mechanical_stack.retention_status: H6 must choose one exact nonconductive serviceable retention route and prevent loosening without loading M1
mechanical_stack.display_installation: owner dry-fits the exact panel and FPC, proves orientation/image/backlight/touch, then bonds it to the PCB using the supplied ready-cut PSA

substeps.title: Placement and mechanical stack
substeps.exit: both PCB outlines, exact footprints, display/FPC slot and relaxed bend, antenna edge, U.FL and microcoax routes, M1, four stops, enclosure capture/datums, wall bearings and exact screw/retention geometry are dimensioned without collision

substeps.title: Routing and net parity
substeps.exit: every reviewed H2 net is routed or intentionally no-connect, and schematic/layout parity plus zero-finding DRC pass

substeps.title: Routed power and thermal verification
substeps.exit: copper, vias, returns, inrush paths, rail drops and thermal estimates retain H3 margins

substeps.title: Digital, USB and M1 signal-integrity review
substeps.exit: direct i8080-8, four USB paths, SDIO/SPI/I2C/UART and all 80 M1 contacts retain the reviewed timing, ownership and return paths

substeps.title: RF and Airband routed review
substeps.exit: ten permanent antenna paths, five microcoax jumpers, RF keepouts, matching networks and Airband extracted parasitics pass without a cross-board RF feed

substeps.title: STEP, enclosure and cable audit
substeps.exit: the full assembled STEP and tolerance stack clear bodies, controls, battery volume, display bend, coax service loops and the one-loose-screw case

substeps.title: Manufacturing and bring-up outputs
substeps.exit: Gerber, drill, BOM, CPL, drawings, assembly notes, programming/recovery access and owner first-power-on inputs are complete and hash-manifested

substeps.title: Independent DFM/CPL and release-candidate review
substeps.exit: the two-board candidate passes independent file/placement/orientation review, yields a real PCBA quote and is ready for the separate F-PO and immutable exact-one order gates

order_time_gates: recheck every exact production MPN against the live JLCPCB Standard PCBA surface
confirm the final SA818S-V pre-order charge and lead time
approve the exact-one-device quote while accepting any supplier PCB panel or minimum quantities
